bootstrap.cluster: key=(namespace,player_id); unique keys sorted by UTF8 bytes of compact JSON [namespace,id]; rows retain canonical stable-key order; K>=2
bootstrap.errors: K<2,zero weighted rows,nonfinite input/replicate,NaN quantile=>fail; all-identical finite allowed
bootstrap.evidence: ordered cluster compact JSON+LF+SHA256; 5000 .17g deltas (-0=>0) compact JSON+LF+SHA256; final bit_generator.state sorted-key compact JSON+LF+SHA256; endpoints .17g
bootstrap.prereq: complete finite candidate+primary predictions; fallbacks=0; lineage/schema/digest failures=0; else fail without bootstrap
bootstrap.stat: candidate weighted MAE-primary weighted MAE; MAE=math.fsum(m*abs(error) frozen cluster/row order)/sum(m*rows_in_cluster); denominator>0; negative favors candidate; all finite
bootstrap.weight: counts=np.bincount(draws,minlength=K); cluster multiplicity m weights every row by m; zero contributes none

gate_math.compare: literal inclusive >=/<= on unrounded finite binary64; equality passes; undefined/nonfinite=>gate false/stage fail

derived.max_season_MAE_regression: max regress(candidate season MAE,primary season MAE) every declared season
derived.mean_season_MAE_delta: fsum(candidate season MAE-primary season MAE)/declared season count,unweighted
derived.position_MAE_regression_ge30: max regress(candidate position MAE,primary position MAE), n>=30
derived.positions_nonworse_MAE: count n>=30 positions candidate MAE<=primary MAE
derived.secondary: for EACH secondary, same pooled rows requiring target/candidate/primary/both secondaries finite; regress(candidate pooled MAE,that secondary MAE); every comparison passes

gate_math.evaluable: OBSERVED target + finite target,candidate,primary; secondary gate additionally both finite secondaries; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED_GATE_INPUT
gate_math.groups: pooled=all evaluable stage rows; position=QB/RB/WR/TE and relative gate only n>=30,no eligible=>fail; season=all positions per declared season,zero rows in any declared season=>fail
gate_math.improve: (B-C)/B positive better; B=0,C=0=>0; B=0,C>0=>FAIL_CLOSED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR; B<0 fatal
gate_math.numeric: finite binary64 CPython3.12.7; math.fsum; math.sqrt; no decision rounding
gate_math.ordering: cell=season x position;n<8 preregistered exclusion; none eligible=>fail. Spearman=ascending average ranks with exact binary64 ties; mx=fsum(rx)/n,my=fsum(ry)/n,num=fsum((rx-mx)*(ry-my)),sx=fsum((rx-mx)^2),sy same,den=sqrt(sx*sy),den=0=>fail,rho=num/den. RankMAE=pred/target descending,ties namespace UTF8 then player_id UTF8,integer ranks1..n,fsum(abs(diff))/n. Weighted=fsum(cell_n*metric in season asc then QB,RB,WR,TE)/fsum(cell_n). Spearman_delta=candidate-primary; rank_regression=regress(candidate,primary).
gate_math.row_order: accepted cohort restricted stage: season asc; position QB,RB,WR,TE; namespace UTF8 bytes; player_id UTF8 bytes
